raw_text:
Laravel app: Fortify v1, Framework v12, Prompts v0, Socialite v5, Flux Free v2, Livewire v4, Boost v2, MCP v0, Pail v1, Pint v1, Sail v1, Pest v4, PHPUnit v12.

MUST activate relevant skills: `fluxui-development` for Flux/UI/forms; `livewire-development` for Livewire/reactivity; `pest-testing` for tests; `tailwindcss-development` for styling; `developing-with-fortify` for authentication.

Follow existing conventions; inspect sibling files. Use descriptive names, reuse components, preserve directory structure. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Do not change dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Be concise.

Use Boost tools: `search-docs` before code changes (version-specific; broad topic queries; no package names), `list-artisan-commands`, `get-absolute-url` for URLs, `tinker` for PHP/Eloquent debugging, `database-query` for reads, `database-schema` before migrations/models, `browser-logs` (recent only). Always use curly braces, constructor property promotion, explicit return types, typed parameters, PHPDoc, array shapes; no empty public constructors. Prefer TitleCase Enum keys.

Every change must be tested. Use Pest; create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`; run `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename/filter. Do NOT delete tests without approval. Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` before finalizing. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`, simply run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix any formatting issues.

Use `php artisan make:` with `--no-interaction` and correct options. Generic classes: `php artisan make:class`. Prefer Eloquent relationships, factories, eager loading, Form Requests, named routes, queues, config over `env()`, and API Resources/versioning. Use Laravel 12 bootstrap configuration. Preserve all column attributes when modifying migrations. Use `casts()` conventions. Use Flux components and Livewire/Alpine appropriately. If frontend changes do not appear, ask about `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.
